response.message: The Sudoku check rejected your submission. Your first step replaced the given 3 and 2 in row one instead of filling its blanks; later, the submitted grid differed from your working grid and still contained blanks. Restart from the original clues. How will you distinguish a fixed clue from a tentative placement so your next revision preserves the actual puzzle? Before resubmitting, compare your final grid directly with the original and use four newline-separated rows.
